# Zamra Travels

> Travel agency in Malappuram, Kerala, India. Books low-fare flight tickets
> between Kerala and the Gulf, and handles visas, visa stamping, certificate
> attestation, Hajj and Umrah packages, and international tour packages.

Note on scope: Google Search ignores this file and states it neither helps nor
harms ranking. It is kept for non-Google AI clients that do read it. Everything
below is also present as crawlable HTML on the pages themselves — this file is a
summary, never the only copy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.zamratravels.com/): Live flight fare search from Kerala to the Gulf, service overview, baggage allowances, contact.
- [Visa services](https://www.zamratravels.com/visa): Tourist and visit visas, visa stamping, certificate attestation, passport services.
- [Hajj & Umrah](https://www.zamratravels.com/hajj-umrah): Umrah and Hajj packages departing from Kerala.
- [Tour packages](https://www.zamratravels.com/tours): International and domestic holiday packages.
- [GCC flight deals](https://www.zamratravels.com/gcc): Per-country WhatsApp groups where daily fares are posted.

## Key facts

- Office: Kizhakkethala, Down Hill, Malappuram, Kerala 676519, India.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98466 06739. Email: zamratravelsmlp@gmail.com.
- Departure airports in India: Kozhikode (CCJ), Kochi (COK), Kannur (CNN),
  Thiruvananthapuram (TRV), Mangaluru (IXE). Bengaluru (BLR), Chennai (MAA),
  Mumbai (BOM), Delhi (DEL) and Hyderabad (HYD) on request.
- Gulf destinations: Dubai (DXB), Sharjah (SHJ), Abu Dhabi (AUH), Ras Al Khaimah
  (RKT), Al Ain (AAN), Fujairah (FJR), Jeddah (JED), Riyadh (RUH), Dammam (DMM),
  Madinah (MED), Doha (DOH), Kuwait (KWI), Bahrain (BAH), Muscat (MCT),
  Salalah (SLL).
- Airlines ticketed: Air India Express (IX), IndiGo (6E), Air Arabia (G9),
  flynas (XY), Oman Air (WY), SalamAir (OV), Air India (AI), Saudia (SV),
  Akasa Air (QP), flydubai (FZ), Jazeera Airways (J9), SpiceJet (SG).
- Standard baggage on quoted fares: 7 kg hand and 30 kg check-in. Exceptions:
  Air Arabia (G9) 10 kg hand; SalamAir (OV) 5 kg hand and 20 or 40 kg check-in;
  Saudia (SV) 20, 30 or 40 kg check-in.
- Booking is consultant-assisted over WhatsApp, phone or the on-site enquiry
  form. There is no self-service online checkout.

## Not for indexing

- /admin, /login, /b2b, /b2b-login — authenticated staff and agent surfaces.
- /deals/<slug> — short-lived fare links broadcast to WhatsApp groups; the
  prices are live and the links are retired when an offer ends.
- /soto — internal testing.
